Well since the rules are created to be followed Knife server rules
It says "- Keep fights fair and only fight 1vs1" and "-Players who fight 2vs1 / 3vs1 etc. will be slayed, kicked or banned"
If there is no admin to see this you can report the player via !calladmin selecting the reason and you should get admin joining the server ASAP.

The last two players are often doing crouch fights, only right click or rush (run towards each other with no stop). Crouch fights are not new.


If someone backstabs you while you do a crouch fight or a other kind of one vs one than he breaks the server rules and will get slayed, kicked or banned.
